result.finding: MySQL (via Azure JDBC), Spring Cloud Config Server, and Netflix Eureka are the external services this application depends on. HSQLDB is included as an in-memory fallback for testing.
evidence: pom.xml: mysql-connector-j runtime dependency - MySQL database driver
pom.xml: hsqldb runtime dependency - in-memory database for testing
pom.xml: spring-cloud-starter-config - Spring Cloud Config Server
application.yml: CONFIG_SERVER_URL (default: http://localhost:8888/) - Config Server endpoint
application.yml (docker profile): config-server:8888 - Config Server in Docker mode
